items.title: Market sell-off deepens as midcaps enter correction zone
items.description: Indian equities, especially the Nifty Midcap 150 index, have recently slipped into correction territory as valuations soar. The small-cap and micro-cap indices are mirroring this trend amid rising investor concerns. Previously, retail investments bolstered smaller stocks, but high valuations threaten future returns. Moreover, analysts observe that even after declines, small and mid-cap stocks continue to trade at elevated levels. An improving economic situation might lead to a hopeful relief rally.

items.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
items.description: Benchmark indices began the day with gains but faced selling pressure as trading continued. The indices eventually closed lower amidst increasing Brent crude oil prices over $110. Analysts suggest that Monday's high of 23,175 is a crucial resistance level to watch. Foreign portfolio investors significantly bought shares, while domestic institutional investors were net buyers as well.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Eternal, Alkem Labs, BEL, HPCL, Swiggy and GMDC
items.description: Indian markets witnessed a downturn on Wednesday, prompted by significant selling in banking stocks. After showing initial promise, the Nifty 50 index dropped by 77.60 points to close at 22,811.35. Reliance Industries celebrated a reaffirmation from ICRA concerning its non-convertible debenture program, valued at Rs 12,000 crore. Eternal also reported impressive year-on-year growth in Q2 revenue and net profits.

items.title: Jefferies sees valuation upside in select IT stocks despite muted growth forecast
items.description: Jefferies has identified opportunities for further valuation gains in selected Indian IT stocks. While the sector experienced a sharp rally in October, growth expectations remain muted. Analysts suggest that lack of negative surprises could drive valuations higher. Infosys and TCS were noted for potential rerating, with target prices increased. The worst-case scenario involves stagnant growth beyond fiscal year 2029 for IT companies.

items.title: Indian banks open cheque books for ₹10,000 crore-plus in M&A funding after RBI rule change
items.description: Indian banks have recently engaged in significant M&A deals after the central bank eased financing rules. State Bank of India and other lenders are now financing up to 75% of deal values. The acquisition-financing market is estimated at nearly ₹2 lakh crore due to increased demand. Various large transactions include Crystal Crop Protection's acquisition of FMC Corporation's India business and others.

items.title: Stock Radar: PVR Inox hits fresh 52-week high in October 2026; what should investors do?
items.description: PVR Inox Ltd has recently reached a 52-week high and is expected to continue its upward trend. The stock has shown over 40% growth over the last three months, signaling strong momentum. Analysts recommend targeting above Rs 1,600 in the coming weeks due to supportive technical indicators. Important support and resistance levels have been identified at Rs 1,300 and Rs 1,650, respectively.

items.title: HDFC Bank begins probe into alleged internal data leak
items.description: HDFC Bank is currently investigating potential leaks of confidential information to social media and other outsiders. This internal review aims to assess compliance with the bank's code of conduct and governance standards. The investigation specifically examines communications involving senior management and other sensitive issues. HDFC Bank confirmed the review process after allegations arose regarding two senior executives' involvement.

items.title: SBI investigates dark web leak of 3.8 lakh records
items.description: State Bank of India is currently investigating a suspected data breach involving customer information found online. The breach reportedly exposed around 375,000 records containing personally identifiable information. SBI activated protocols and engaged cybersecurity experts to assess the extent of the breach. Preliminary analysis revealed that 3,897 customer records included sensitive personal data. Despite this incident, the bank's core business operations and financial performance remain unaffected.

items.title: KEI Industries shares tumble 8% despite Q2 profit rising 29%, revenue up 39%
items.description: KEI Industries shares fell despite strong Q2 FY27 results, with net profit rising 29% and revenue growing 39% year on year. Growth was supported by domestic wires and cables demand, higher dealer sales and improved profitability in the first half.

items.title: M&M Financial Services shares crash 10% after Q2 results. What are Nomura and other analysts saying?
items.description: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services shares fell sharply on  despite a 55% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 882 crore. Nomura lowered its target price to Rs 400 while retaining a Buy rating, citing asset quality concerns and rising funding costs. Motilal Oswal maintained its Buy rating.

items.title: ABB India among 4 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 21, four stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 10% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Eternal shares jump 2% after strong Q2 show, brokerages see up to 34% upside
items.description: Eternal shares rose after Q2FY27 net profit surged 92.3% year-on-year to Rs 125 crore, while revenue jumped 77.6% to Rs 24,138 crore. Jefferies maintained a Buy rating and raised its target price to Rs 430, implying 34% upside

items.title: ₹4 lakh crore rally, ₹6,500 crore FII buying: Are IT stocks finally making a comeback?
items.description: Indian IT stocks experienced a notable market value recovery of approximately ₹3.87 lakh crore in October. Foreign investors invested around ₹6,463 crore in the IT sector during the third quarter. The Nifty IT index rose about 17 percent in October after a previous decline of roughly 20 percent. Analysts caution that despite selective buying, the sector faces a challenging earnings environment ahead.

items.title: IHCL shares rise 3% as firm raises FY27 guidance. What Jefferies, other brokerages are saying?
items.description: IHCL reported a 22% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 revenue to Rs 2,484 crore and a 23% increase in net profit to Rs 349.49 crore. The hotel major raised its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 15-17%. Jefferies, Nomura and Nuvama shared their latest ratings and target prices.

items.title: Why is market falling today? Sensex drops 600 points, Nifty below 22,600. Key factors behind Rs 5 lakh crore rout
items.description: Indian stock markets fell sharply on Thursday, with Sensex dropping over 600 points and Nifty 50 slipping below 22,600 amid expiry-day volatility. The selloff wiped out nearly Rs 5 lakh crore in investor wealth, while broader markets, sectoral indices and market breadth remained firmly negative.

items.title: Ravita Engineering Services shares to list today: Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Ravita Engineering Services is set to debut on the NSE SME platform on Thursday, with a muted grey market premium of around 1%, indicating a potentially modest listing gain. The Rs 116.05 crore IPO, priced at Rs 105–112 per share, was subscribed 7.11 times overall. QIBs led demand with 13.21 times subscription, followed by NIIs at 7.42 times and individual investors at 3.50 times.

items.title: Fusion CX shares list at 6% premium over IPO price
items.description: Fusion CX made its stock market debut after raising Rs 702 crore through its IPO. Strong subscription, rising profits, AI investments and expansion plans shape investor expectations.

items.title: PC Jeweller shares soar 9% after Q2 net profit rises 58% YoY; plans 100 new stores in 18 months
items.description: PC Jeweller reported a 58% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 330.66 crore, while revenue grew 28% to Rs 1,054.47 crore. The company achieved debt-free status, improving profitability prospects. It plans 100 new showrooms, a youth-focused jewellery brand, and expects gold mining operations to begin this financial year.

items.title: Fractal Analytics among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 21, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.An RSI Trending Up signal occurs when the Relative Strength Index (RSI) crosses above 50 from below, indicating strengthening momentum in a stock’s price. RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: HFCL among 3 stocks closing below VWAP
items.description: On October 21, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 2% below their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume. A closing price below VWAP indicates that the stock ended the session below its volume-weighted average traded price.

items.title: Sobha among 4 stocks closing above VWAP
items.description: On October 21, the closing prices of four stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1.5% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data.When a stock closes above VWAP, it means its closing price is higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Dividend alert! Last day to buy HDB Financial, Tech Mahindra, LTM among 10 stocks for dividend rewards
items.description: Under Sebi’s T+1 settlement cycle, investors need to purchase a company’s shares at least one trading day before the record date to ensure the shares are credited to their demat accounts in time, and they become eligible for the corporate action. Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy the shares so that they are credited to their accounts by the record date (October 23), making them eligible for the dividend.

items.title: NSE shares in focus as IPO lock-in expiry frees up stake worth Rs 3,247 crore for trade. How the stock performed in a month since listing
items.description: At the previous closing price of Rs 1,709 apiece on BSE, the said number of shares freeing up for trade today is worth nearly Rs 3,247 crore.

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 8 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty200 pack, eight stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 21, according to technical scan data from StockEdge. Trading below the 200 DMA is generally considered a negative signal, as it suggests that a stock’s price is below its long-term trend. The 200 DMA is a widely used technical indicator that helps traders assess a stock's overall trend.

items.title: RIL stock: Jio's listing could unlock value, but will it drive a re-rating?
items.description: The anticipated IPO of Jio Platforms is likely to reshape valuation assessments for both Reliance Industries and Bharti Airtel. With Jio's market debut, Reliance may witness a decrease in its holding-company discount. Meanwhile, Airtel stands to gain from rising telecom tariffs, boosting average revenue per user and overall profitability. The enthusiasm from investors towards Jio's IPO highlights strong market confidence in the sector's trajectory.

items.title: Amagi Media Labs shares fall 3% after company flags cyber extortion attempt
items.description: Amagi Media Labs shares dropped on Thursday after the company disclosed a cyber extortion attempt involving allegedly obtained operational and network configuration data. The company is investigating the claim with external cybersecurity experts and legal counsel, while stating that services remain unaffected and no material financial impact is expected at this stage.

items.title: D-Street's margin-funded stock bets fall as smallcap rally falters
items.description: Retail traders in India are reducing their leveraged bets on stocks as the market showcases a decline. Recently, borrowed positions dropped to 1.56 trillion rupees after a record high in September. The NSE 500 Index has decreased almost 9% from its peak, pushing small- and mid-caps down significantly. Furthermore, higher interest rates and persistent oil prices have added pressure to the equity market.

items.title: Stock crash alert! eMudhra shares plunge 37% in just two sessions. What’s unfolding?
items.description: eMudhra shares plunged 37% in two sessions after a critical security incident involving compromised private keys linked to eight intermediate Certificate Authority certificates. MeitY said its Indian digital signature and eSign services remain unaffected. The affected global TLS business contributes around 1% of revenue, but reputational risks remain.

items.title: Never a dull moment! Why Jefferies raised Eternal’s target price after Q2 earnings
items.description: Jefferies raised its target price on Eternal to Rs 430 from Rs 415, implying around 38% upside from its previous close of Rs 312.35. The brokerage cited Blinkit’s faster store expansion and improving unit economics, food delivery growth of over 20%, and rising confidence in District.

items.title: NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX indices to foray into equity and derivatives markets
items.description: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two rule-based indices covering large and liquid Indian equities and financial sector stocks. The benchmarks use a multi-factor methodology incorporating market capitalisation, liquidity, beta and volatility, with semi-annual rebalancing.

items.title: Ashish Kacholia portfolio: Ace investor adds 3 new stocks, trims stake in 13 companies in Q2
items.description: Ace investor Ashish Kacholia reshuffled his Rs 3,000 crore portfolio in Q2FY27, adding three stocks, increasing stakes in two companies and trimming holdings in 13 others. The changes include new bets on ESDS Software Solutions, Ardee Industries and Credent Connect N Care, while Fineotex Chemicals and Brand Concepts may have been exited.

items.title: Adani Green Energy shares fall 4% after Q2 results. What are Jefferies, JM Financial saying?
items.description: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 673 crore, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Shares fell 4% after the results. Jefferies maintained its Buy rating, while JM Financial retained Add, citing growth opportunities and operational challenges.

items.title: IGI shares hit 10% upper circuit as Q2 profit jumps 43%, revenue rises 31% YoY
items.description: International Gemological Institute shares hit the 10% upper circuit after Q2 FY27 revenue rose 31% and profit surged 43% year on year. Growth was supported by lab-grown diamonds, stronger margins and rising demand across jewellery and coloured gemstones.

items.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Dark.ai could be Eternal’s dark horse, but is it too early to bet?
items.description: Eternal’s Dark.ai, a privacy-focused AI assistant developed under Deepinder Goyal, could open a new growth avenue for the company. While brokerages see potential in the experimental venture, its commercial viability remains untested. With pricing, monetisation and profitability still unclear, investors may have to wait before assessing its earnings potential.

items.title: Swiggy shares slide over 5% ahead of Q2 results. What are analysts saying?
items.description: Swiggy shares fell ahead of its Q2 FY27 results as investors assessed its path to profitability. Anand Rathi upgraded the stock to Buy, while rival Eternal reported strong earnings growth, supported by food delivery and quick commerce.

items.title: Sebi warns investors against WhatsApp stock tips. Here's how you can avoid such traps
items.description: SEBI has cautioned investors against exclusive WhatsApp groups spreading unauthorised stock tips and fake profit claims. The regulator flagged astroturfing, overseas numbers, replacement groups and suspicious trading apps, urging investors to verify credentials and use registered intermediaries.

items.title: NCDEX launches NDEX and FINNDEX to expand into equity benchmarks
items.description: NCDEX has launched NDEX and FINNDEX, two equity benchmarks tracking 20 large, liquid Indian stocks and 15 financial sector companies. Their multi-factor methodology incorporates market capitalisation, trading activity, beta and volatility, with semiannual rebalancing.

items.title: 10 stocks plunge up to 53% from their yearly peaks
items.description: India’s equity markets have witnessed heightened volatility, with the benchmark NIFTY50 falling nearly 14% from its 52-week high and the NIFTY Midcap 150 declining around 10% from its peak. The correction has hit several midcap stocks particularly hard, with some plunging 40% to 53% from their respective 52-week highs. Here, we noted 10 midcap stocks that have suffered the steepest declines, significantly underperforming the broader market amid the ongoing sell-off. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Sebi allows margin relief against early pay-in of securities for subsequent trades
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has announced a new directive that eases margin requirements for clients with a net sell obligation. This policy is particularly applicable when early pay-in requests are accepted by the clearing corporation, allowing clients to execute trades more efficiently. No margin will be collected on future trades up to the value of accepted early pay-in securities.

items.title: Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Cipla, Nestle India, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
items.description: Indian equity markets fell for a third consecutive session as weak global cues and sustained selling weighed on sentiment. The Nifty 50 declined 0.54% to 22,688, while the Sensex dropped 0.62% to 73,249.

items.title: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in wealth manager 360 ONE WAM through warrant exercise
items.description: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising 2.05 crore warrants and paying around Rs 1,584 crore. The transaction follows a partnership announced in April 2025, under which UBS agreed to sell its Indian onshore wealth management business to the Mumbai-based firm for about $32 million.

items.title: Weekly Top Picks: These stocks scored 10 on 10 on Stock Reports Plus
items.description: Stock Reports Plus, powered by Refinitiv, undertakes detailed company analysis for 4,000+ listed stocks. In addition to detailed company analyses, the report also collates analysts’ forecasts and trend analysis for each component. An average score in Stock Reports Plus is calculated by undertaking quantitative analysis of five key investment tools – earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum.

items.title: Every bad cycle ends the same way; problems find their own solutions: 5 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 27%
items.description: What should you focus on when headwinds blow? Not the share price, and not the morning's news. It should be the business and the quality of the people running it. A strong business, run by a management that has proven it knows what it is doing, does not stop because the oil price went up or because a war has dragged on longer than anyone expected.
